PROP-e5782b58-asm-006.text: Supabase anon key client must enforce RLS; no RLS-bypassing queries via anon client.
PROP-e5782b58-asm-006.assertion: forall query via anon_client: RLS policies active AND enforced

locations.note: Standard user queries use createClient() with NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY. The SSR client (createServerClient from @supabase/ssr) respects RLS via user JWT cookies.
Browser-side client (if any) also uses NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY — RLS is enforced via Supabase platform.
